clues.text: God told Noah to build it of gopher wood, with rooms, and coat it with pitch inside and out.
God gave Noah its size: three hundred cubits long, fifty cubits wide, and thirty cubits high.
Creatures came to Noah two by two, male and female, to go inside it as God commanded.
For forty days the flood kept coming, and the rising waters lifted it high above the earth.
When God sent a wind and the flood waters went down, it came to rest on the mountains of Ararat.
Finding no place to rest her foot, the dove flew back, and Noah reached out and brought her inside it.
By faith Noah, warned about things not yet seen, built it in godly fear to save his family.
